Connection forms relabel their fields, so a "password" key very often holds the
LABEL shown to the user rather than a credential. Airflow's provider metadata is
full of these, and every one of them used to trip the password-assignment rule.

"relabeling": {"login": "Client ID", "password": "Client Secret"},
"relabeling": {"host": "Chime Webhook Endpoint", "password": "Webhook Token"},
"password": "Blob Storage Connection String",
RESOURCE_MY_PASSWORD = "My Password"
api_key = "Enter your key in the settings page"
secret: "This value is provided by the operator"
